$description: Figma to code map for beefcake-platform. Hand-maintained stand-in for Figma Code Connect, which requires an Organization plan; this workspace is on Professional. Read this whenever you are given a Figma URL from the Beefcake design system file.

tokens.rule: Every Figma variable name maps to the Tailwind class of the same leaf name. Figma 'status/good-soft' is the class 'good-soft', used as bg-good-soft or text-good-soft. Figma 'space/16' is Tailwind step 4 (p-4, gap-4): the Figma name is the pixel value because Figma variable names cannot contain a dot. Figma 'text/sm' is text-sm.

State.note: Presentational only. default and hover are CSS states; disabled is the native disabled attribute. Never emit a state prop.

Button.notes: LinkButton is visually identical and renders a next/link anchor. Use LinkButton with href when the design shows a button that navigates, Button otherwise. The Figma component covers both.

Badge.notes: tone is the Tone union exported from the same file and shared with StatTile, Meter and Callout.
